title: Herbal Creamy Egyptian Broad Beans Stew
description: A velvety, herb-infused Egyptian stew featuring tender broad beans, fermented tomato flavor, and a dash of tahini for richness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic; sauté until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, turmeric, and the bay leaf; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fermented tomato paste and stir until well combined with the spices.
Pour in the vegetable stock, then add the broad beans; bring to a gentle simmer and cook until the beans are tender, about 30 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley, cilantro, lemon juice, salt, and pepper; adjust seasoning as desired.
Fold in the tahini until the stew achieves a creamy consistency; if the mixture seems too thick, add a splash of water or more stock.
Taste for balance; add honey if a touch of sweetness is preferred, then remove from heat.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh herbs if desired.
